general_notes:
I much prefer the elements as gameplay shape/rythm/utility more so than as elemental counters because then it makes more than just color matching gameplay.

We need to be careful about too many things beating armor, and magic being the answer to both armor and evasion. Need to make sure our first subset isn't too lopsided

There's a big confusion between special stats and statuses, the distinction is unclear. I didn't make that not everywhere, so I focused on effect not stat vs status effect distinction

Quite a few classes overlap (various versions of voodoo/curses/disease and tanky healer/support, guardian/team cover). Mentioned it once then stopped mentioning it

cards.name: Fire
cards.line: Big, hungry, all-out damage.
cards.yours: Ramping damage; Burn, a DoT proportional to health.
cards.note: All-out damage is a bit vague no? Do they mean high mana cost?

cards.name: Ice
cards.line: Slow and steady; it stalls and grinds foes down.
cards.yours: Consistent, reliable damage; the tempo debuff element: slows, weakens, etc.

cards.name: Lightning
cards.line: Sudden strikes that jump between foes.
cards.yours: AoE; Shock, which hurts fast units by damaging on action.

cards.name: Earth
cards.line: Heavy and grinding: stone and mountains.
cards.yours: Low damage in general, with spiky high-damage, lower-accuracy hits; shields and poison.
cards.note: You're right, we shouldn't add spell missing here, maybe it needs a new gimmick

cards.name: Wind
cards.line: Light, quick cuts.
cards.yours: Multi-hit focus; crit, evasion and speed.

cards.name: Light
cards.line: Holy fire; heals, shields and sears the dead.
cards.yours: Strong spells on non-offensive classes: healing, regen and revive. Rarely resisted, but rarely used by offensive classes.
cards.note: I don't like this "the dead" thing we shouldn't worry about enemy themes here

cards.name: Dark
cards.line: Curses, draining and the grave.
cards.yours: Middle-of-the-road regular damage (dark magic as a basic attack); powerful but often resisted; esoteric effects.
cards.note: Curses and the grave are undefined meanings here

cards.name: Water
cards.line: Tides and drowning, a crushing weight.
cards.note: This description is meaningless unfortunately

cards.name: Arcane
cards.line: Raw magic: almost nothing resists it, and nothing is weak to it.

cards.name: Nature
cards.line: Regenerative or toxic.

cards.name: Spirit
cards.line: Souls; the one thing that truly hurts ghosts.

cards.name: Poison
cards.line: Steady damage on a timer; doses stack.
cards.yours: Consistent DoT.

cards.name: Regen
cards.line: Heals a little on a timer.

cards.name: Haste
cards.line: Acts faster: attacks, cooldowns or wind-ups.

cards.name: Stun
cards.line: Can't act, and loses what it was winding up.
cards.yours: Freeze (stun).

cards.name: Shield
cards.line: Soaks a pool of damage before HP.

cards.name: Silence
cards.line: Can't use abilities, only basic attacks.

cards.name: Chill
cards.line: Acts slower; some versions stack, and one freezes at 5 stacks.
cards.yours: Chilled: slow, and decrease evasion.

cards.name: Taunt
cards.line: Foes are forced to attack this unit.
cards.note: This would be a buff on the taunter

cards.name: Doom
cards.line: A countdown that ends in one big hit, or a knockout, unless removed first.
cards.note: I worry about starting with "unless someone removes it" as a condition in an auto-battled, but the gameplay is nice

cards.name: Vulnerable
cards.line: Takes more damage: of every kind, or of one element.
cards.note: Could be more conditional, like next hit too, this is what I meant by Mark for Death

cards.name: Burn
cards.line: Damage over time that ramps up, or burns hot.
cards.yours: Ramping damage over time (your Fire: proportional to health).

cards.name: Marked
cards.line: Draws fire: the other side targets it more, takes more damage, or both.
cards.note: This feels too mechanically complex from the targeting side for a first pass

cards.name: Berserk
cards.line: Hits harder, at a cost: weaker defences, more damage taken, or no abilities.
cards.yours: Rage: strength up, tankiness down.

cards.name: Shock
cards.line: Takes damage each time it acts, so it hurts fast units most.
cards.yours: Shock: damage on attack.

cards.name: Bleed
cards.line: Physical-feeling damage over time. Versions differ: bursty, stacking per hit, or worse when hit.
cards.yours: Big damage but hard to maintain stacks.
cards.note: I prefer my version here, but all damage status effects need to be defined one from the others

cards.name: Stat buffs and debuffs
cards.line: Plain ups and downs: Attack (Might), damage dealt (Weakened), Armor, crit, auras.
cards.note: Ideally we find thematic bundles and we're not just directly stat downing people

cards.name: Hidden
cards.line: Can't be targeted, or is targeted less, for a while or until it acts.
cards.note: Unclear if needed when taunt exists

cards.name: Sunder
cards.line: Armor lowered, stacking or for good.
cards.note: We might not need this and armor pen in the same subset, it's all about number checks vs counters

cards.name: Guard
cards.line: Takes less damage, or has more Armor, for a while.
cards.note: For a minimum subset I'd probably try this giving resistance as well if we included it

cards.name: Focus
cards.line: Its next hits are stronger, or crit chance builds until it's struck or misses.

cards.name: Reraise
cards.line: Comes back from a knockout once, or survives one.
cards.yours: Your Cleric and Holy both revive.

cards.name: Rot
cards.line: Heals do less, or partly hurt.

cards.name: Enchant
cards.line: Its attacks carry something extra: elemental damage, a new element, or a status.
cards.note: Very cool, need to make sure it's useful

cards.name: Purified
cards.line: Can't gain debuffs for a while, or ignores the next few.

cards.name: Blind
cards.line: Its physical hits often miss.

cards.name: Blink
cards.line: Each stack makes one hit miss outright.

cards.name: Stone
cards.line: Can't act, but takes almost no damage.

cards.name: Momentum
cards.line: Builds with each hit landed; a miss drops it.
cards.note: Is this fun or just a pass/fail win depending on foe's evasion

cards.name: Root
cards.line: Can't dodge: Evasion set to zero.
cards.note: Really depends on the enemies and which other answers exist, because right now magic hard counters dodge

cards.name: Soul Link
cards.line: Part of the damage it takes is passed to a linked foe.

cards.name: Lifesteal
cards.line: Heals for a share of the damage it deals.

cards.name: Evasion
cards.line: Chance to dodge a physical hit.

cards.name: Armor penetration
cards.line: Ignores some of the target's Armor on each hit.

cards.name: Accuracy
cards.line: Cancels out the target's Evasion.
cards.note: Magic counters evasion for now, unsure of necessity

cards.name: Crit damage
cards.line: How much harder its crits hit.
cards.note: Crit build simulation tells us if we need this

cards.name: Thorns
cards.line: Whoever hits it takes damage back.

cards.name: Execute
cards.line: More damage against low-HP targets.
cards.note: Classic ability effect, less compelling when represented as a stat

cards.name: Counter
cards.line: Chance to strike back when hit.
cards.yours: Riposte (a status): dodge and attack.
cards.note: Overlap with thorns, maybe variety is good, maybe it's too much

cards.name: Potency
cards.line: Its statuses land better: more stacks, more often, or for longer.

cards.name: Tenacity
cards.line: Debuffs on it wear off faster, or fail to land.
cards.note: I wouldn't start with debuff resist as a stat, if we try it it's as an ability effect

cards.name: Double strike
cards.line: Chance a basic attack hits again.
cards.yours: Double hit (a status).

cards.name: Combo
cards.line: Builds with consecutive hits; empowers the next hits or ability.
cards.note: Definitely a class gimmick and not core set

cards.name: Echo
cards.line: Chance an ability goes off a second time.
cards.note: A cool gimmick, very likely not core set

cards.name: Overflow
cards.line: Healing past full HP becomes a shield.
cards.note: Might not pick this and explicit shields application for a first subset

cards.name: Cast speed
cards.line: Shorter wind-ups on abilities.

cards.name: Mana leech
cards.line: Restores MP from damage dealt or from acting.

cards.name: Rage
cards.line: A meter that fills from taking (or dealing) damage and fuels power.
cards.note: Too complex for what it does for now

cards.name: Soul
cards.line: Charges gained when units are knocked out, spent on big effects.

cards.name: Heat
cards.line: Builds as it attacks; vents a burst, or overheats into a self-debuff.

cards.name: Companion
cards.line: A pet or bond that adds extra attacks.
cards.note: Summons aren't base set unless tech needs to start now for eventual support

cards.name: Splash
cards.line: Part of each hit also lands on another foe.
cards.note: "Other" is too generic right now for me

cards.name: Stagger
cards.line: Chance a hit cancels the target's wind-up.

cards.name: Stealth
cards.line: Starts the fight untargetable.

cards.name: Block
cards.line: Chance to shrink a physical hit by a large share.
cards.note: This just doubles up armor

cards.name: Cover
cards.line: Takes hits, or part of the damage, aimed at a hurt ally.
cards.note: Without player chosen targeting this seems like worse taunt?

cards.name: Elemental damage
cards.line: More damage of one element, a line per element.
cards.yours: Elemental damage (per type).

cards.name: Healing power
cards.line: Its heals are stronger.

cards.name: Detonate
cards.line: Pops statuses on a foe for burst damage.
cards.note: Potentially cool ability effect, esoteric to start though

cards.name: Attack speed
cards.line: Faster basic attacks.

cards.name: Threat
cards.line: How likely foes are to target it.
cards.note: This and taunt need to be rationalized together and only both included if it makes sense

cards.name: Purity
cards.line: Takes less magic damage, until elements wear it down.
cards.note: No clue what until éléments wear it down means

cards.name: Weight
cards.line: Heavier gear adds blunt damage.

cards.name: Mana burn
cards.line: Its hits drain the target's MP.

cards.name: Charge
cards.line: Fills over time; empties into one big action a fight.

cards.name: Resonance
cards.line: Its next spell of the same element hits harder.
cards.note: No player choice

cards.name: Decay
cards.line: Statuses on its target run out faster.

cards.name: Copy
cards.line: Copies a status from a foe or ally.

cards.name: Foresight
cards.line: Warns of the next heavy hit and gives a short defensive window.

cards.name: Head start
cards.line: Its cooldowns start the fight partway done.
cards.note: Cool itemization thing to prevent resource attrition through trash mobs

cards.name: Overkill
cards.line: Damage past a knockout spills onto another foe.

cards.name: Spite
cards.line: When knocked out, damages every foe.
cards.note: Very cool buildmaking

cards.name: Poise
cards.line: Chance to keep a wind-up when something would cancel it.

cards.name: Cleric
cards.line: Heals the most hurt ally and lifts debuffs.
cards.yours: Squishy, heals and revives, pocket burst damage.

cards.name: Paladin
cards.line: A holy knight who fights, shields and heals a little.
cards.yours: Guardian: tanky healer with physical scaling.
cards.note: Paladin and knight might too much overlap for a core set unless one gets differentiated a bit more

cards.name: Monk
cards.line: A martial artist: many quick hits, combos, dodges and counters.
cards.yours: Dodge tank with heals.
cards.note: Combo does not feel like a core subset element, but dodge tank does

cards.name: Ranger
cards.line: Steady ranged damage that marks prey for the party.
cards.yours: Archer: consistent high sustained damage, but squishy.

cards.name: Mage
cards.line: Elemental caster: big hits, fragile.
cards.yours: Fire and lightning, ramping damage in a squishy shell.
cards.note: Potentially more than one type of mage

cards.name: Rogue
cards.line: A quick, evasive blade whose dodges turn into crits.
cards.yours: Evasive, high burst damage but weak sustained attack.

cards.name: Bard
cards.line: Songs or dances that buff the whole party.
cards.yours: Dancer: pure buffer.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.line: Stronger the nearer it gets to death.

cards.name: Knight
cards.line: An armored wall that draws attacks: taunts, guards, shields.
cards.note: Paladin and knight might too much overlap for a core set unless one gets differentiated a bit more

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.line: Shadow magic: drains, curses, doom; feeds on knockouts.
cards.note: Gameplay seems interesting, Necromancer is a misnomer without summons, which we won't have at first.

cards.name: Alchemist
cards.line: Flasks: poisons and debuffs for foes, potions for allies.

cards.name: Time mage
cards.line: Speeds allies, slows and stops foes.
cards.note: Don't hate it, but we need really spiky time abilities otherwelse it's a chill bot. Very much cool or not cool depending on specific design

cards.name: Voodoo
cards.line: Little damage, many stacking curses.
cards.yours: Pure debuff.
cards.note: Plague doctor and voodoo seem like the same thing to me

cards.name: Spellblade
cards.line: Puts an element on weapons: its own, or an ally's.

cards.name: Priest
cards.line: Healing over time and protection; most lists make it a druid.
cards.yours: Squishy, regen, support, pocket heals.

cards.name: Brigand
cards.line: Heavy hits that break or pierce armor.
cards.yours: High damage, low accuracy, medium survivability, shreds armor.
cards.note: Non-magical counter to armor

cards.name: Assassin
cards.line: A burst killer that finishes the wounded.
cards.yours: Taunt-ignoring burst killer.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.line: An off-tank that lives on lifesteal.
cards.yours: Lifesteal off-tank.

cards.name: Templar
cards.line: Anti-debuff: cleanses, resists, and keeps debuffs off the party.

cards.name: Plague doctor
cards.line: Spreads poison and sickness; it jumps when its holder falls.
cards.note: Plague doctor and voodoo seem like the same thing to me

cards.name: Oracle
cards.line: Foresight: marks or dooms foes, shields or blinks allies before the blow.

cards.name: Fencer
cards.line: Duels one foe; parries and counters.

cards.name: Hoplite
cards.line: A shield-bearer who makes the whole party sturdier.

cards.name: Spellbreaker
cards.line: Strips foes' buffs and shields, and silences casters.
cards.note: Unsure of practical utility as main class role

cards.name: Soldier
cards.line: An all-round front-liner: a little tanky, a little offensive.
cards.yours: Middle-of-the-road physical class: a little tanky and a little offensive.

cards.name: Samurai
cards.line: Long wind-ups that land huge, crit-heavy cuts.

cards.name: Beastmaster
cards.line: Fights beside a pet that adds its own strikes.

cards.name: Blood mage
cards.line: Pays its own HP for power; losing HP restores MP.
cards.note: Could be convinced, but doesn't seem core to me

cards.name: Duelist
cards.line: Attack speed and crits, squishy and slightly evasive.
cards.yours: Attack speed and crit king, squishy and slightly evasive.
cards.note: Potentially too vanilla if other roles operate similarly

cards.name: Pyromancer
cards.line: A fire specialist: stacking, spreading burns.

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.line: Revives allies, and grows stronger as units fall.

cards.name: Onmyoji
cards.line: Talismans that silence and seal; wards for allies.

cards.name: Illusionist
cards.line: Mirror images and decoys that make hits miss.

cards.name: Frostweaver
cards.line: Frost that piles up until foes freeze.

cards.name: Reaper
cards.line: Harvests knockouts into power and big hits.

cards.name: Gunslinger
cards.line: Rapid-fire shots that shred armor, with reloads or overheating.
cards.note: No reload mechanic, stick to cooldown for now

cards.name: Bramble knight
cards.line: A tank that punishes whoever hits it.
cards.yours: Thorns tank.

cards.name: Ninja
cards.line: Starts hidden, throws poison, hard to pin down.

cards.name: Dragoon
cards.line: Leaps out of reach and lands one huge hit.
cards.note: Just a final fantasy rip-off, can find a better fantasy for this gameplay, it's basically an evasive samurai

cards.name: Trapper
cards.line: Sets timed statuses on foes, then detonates them.
cards.note: Wouldn't start with this, too many complex ally status effect interactions

cards.name: Earth martial artist
cards.line: Uneven damage, with support and debuffs.
cards.yours: Inconsistent DPS with support and debuff potential.

cards.name: Dark knight
cards.line: An armor tank that deals magic damage.
cards.yours: Armor tank with magic damage.
cards.note: Paladin in a different color

cards.name: Pegasus warrior
cards.line: A resistance tank that also deals damage.
cards.yours: Resist tank with damage.
cards.note: I think this is

cards.name: Martyr
cards.line: Spends its own HP to heal; its fall heals and shields the party.

cards.name: Gorgon
cards.line: Turns the strongest foe to stone, which hurts when it cracks.
cards.note: Target strongest foe is an ability not a whole class

cards.name: Einherjar
cards.line: Fights hard and dies loudly; its war cry outlives it.

cards.name: Dancer
cards.line: An evasive dancer who debuffs foes and charms one.
cards.note: Doesn't necessarily need to be charm, evasive debuffer is a classic hard to make work class but satisfying

cards.name: Geomancer
cards.line: Lingering elemental fields that power up later spells.
cards.note: Earth magic caster sure why not, but not when described this way

cards.name: Engineer
cards.line: Deploys turrets and gadgets that attack or shield.

cards.name: Artillerist
cards.line: Huge, slow blunt blasts; heavier gear hits harder.
cards.note: Unclear fantasy and gameplay

cards.name: Mimic
cards.line: Copies statuses from foes and allies.
